why does tracking your money feel harder than earning it?

No clutter, no friction. Just transparency and control.

Design can make financial literacy feel effortless - this is a step in that direction.

Conversation modals designed for ClozerAI - an AI sales call assistant app.

Main UI & UX patterns used:

→ Strong primary CTA that instantly draws focus to “Start Session”

→ Clear hierarchy that presents key info without breaking the call flow

→ AI-help buttons made prominent, visible exactly when it’s needed

→ Subtle call indicators (timer, recording), noticeable without distracting the salesperson
